1.1: This here the heavy word on Nineveh. Nahum from Elkosh saw it all in a vision.
1.2: God don't play when He jealous. The Lord don't miss when He pay folks back. Yeah, He mad for real — and He keep that smoke for His enemies.
1.3: The Lord got patience, but don't get it twisted — He powerful. He ain't lettin' the wicked slide. He move through the whirlwind and storm like He own 'em. Even the clouds? Just dust on His feet.
1.4: When He speak, the sea dry up. Rivers gone. Bashan and Carmel shrivel up. Lebanon? Lookin' dead and dusty.
1.5: Mountains shake in front of Him. Hills melt like butter. The earth straight-up tremble when He show up — everybody on it too.
1.6: Who can handle that kind of heat? Who gon' stand tall in that anger? His rage hit like wildfire, and rocks crumble when He mad.
1.7: But don't get it twisted — the Lord is good too. He like a safe place when life hit hard. He know who really trustin' Him.
1.8: But His enemies? He floodin' their spot. Gonna wipe it clean. Darkness gon' chase 'em down.
1.9: Y'all think y'all can plot on God? He gon' shut all that down — for good. That affliction? Ain't comin' back a second time.
1.10: Even if y'all tangled up and wild drunk, God gon' burn y'all up like dry brush in a fire.
1.11: Somebody from y'all crew out here schemin' against the Lord — plotting evil, runnin' they mouth.
1.12: But God said: "They might look safe. Might be plenty of 'em. But when I pass through, they gettin' chopped down. Yeah, I let you suffer for a minute, But that pain? I'm done with it."
1.13: "I'm breakin' that heavy chain off your neck. Snappin' them ropes. You free now."
1.14: God done spoke on this one: "Your name? Ain't nobody gonna remember it. I'ma smash your idols — carved or molded. Diggin' your grave myself, 'cause you foul."
1.15: Look! Somebody runnin' up in the hills, Bringing good news, shouting peace! Judah, go head and celebrate your feasts. Keep your vows. That wicked man? He ain't ever walkin' through here again. He gone. For good.

2.1: Look who pullin' up now — the one who scatters everything in sight. Better guard the gate, post up on the road, tighten up your crew, and get your strength up.
2.2: 'Cause the Lord about to bring Jacob back to glory — just like He did with Israel. Y'all tore up their vines and left 'em dry, but He fixin' to restore what y'all wrecked.
2.3: His warriors stay ready — shields shined up red, soldiers drippin' in scarlet. Them chariots lit up like fire, swords flashin' like it's go time.
2.4: Chariots tearin' through the city streets, runnin' wild in the open roads. They movin' like fireballs, lightnin' fast.
2.5: He tryin' to rally his top men — but they stumblin' all over the place. They rush to the wall, scramblin' to hold the line.
2.6: But the river gates bust wide open — palace crumblin', foundations gone.
2.7: It's already written: She gettin' dragged off into exile. Her ladies cryin' soft like doves, beatin' on their chests in sorrow.
2.8: Nineveh used to be calm like a pool of water. Now? Everybody runnin' for their lives. "Stop! Stop!" they yell — but ain't nobody stoppin'.
2.9: Snatch that silver! Grab all the gold! Treasure everywhere — more riches than they can count.
2.10: Now it's all gone. The place empty, destroyed, silent. Hearts droppin', knees bucklin', everybody shakin', faces pale as ghosts.
2.11: Where's that lion den now? The spot where the big cats used to roam free — lion, lioness, and cubs? Ain't nobody scared back then.
2.12: That lion used to kill what he wanted, feedin' his fam, stackin' up meat in his cave like trophies.
2.13: But now God said: "I'm comin' for you. Your chariots? Burned up. Your young soldiers? Gettin' cut down. Your prey? Gone. And your messengers? Ain't nobody gon' hear from them again."

3.1: Woe to that bloodstained city! Full of lies, full of theft — and the violence? Never quits.
3.2: You hear it? Whips crackin', wheels rattlin', horses poundin' the ground, chariots clankin' down the street.
3.3: Warriors ridin' in swords drawn, spears flashin' — Bodies everywhere. Dead piled high. Folks trippin' over corpses 'cause the streets so full of 'em.
3.4: And why? 'Cause this city was out here seducin' nations like a smooth-talkin' harlot — witchcraft in her hands, spells castin' families and countries into her trap.
3.5: "I'm comin' for you," says the Lord of Heaven's Armies. "I'ma snatch your skirt up over your head and let the world see you exposed. Everybody gon' see your shame.
3.6: I'ma throw filth on you, drag your name through the mud, and turn you into a spectacle.
3.7: Folks gon' run the other way like, 'Dang! Nineveh done for!' Ain't nobody cryin' over you. Ain't even no one to comfort you."
3.8: You thought you was better than No Amon? That city by the Nile? She had water for walls, rivers for defense.
3.9: Ethiopia and Egypt had her back, Put and Libya too — a whole army of allies. But guess what?
3.10: She still got snatched up, kids murdered in the streets, leaders rolled like dice for fun, and all her bosses got chained up.
3.11: Now it's your turn. You gon' get drunk and disappear, hidin' from your enemies, lookin' for shelter.
3.12: Your fortresses? They soft — like ripe figs just waitin' to fall into someone's mouth.
3.13: Your soldiers? Like scared women in the middle of war. Your gates? Wide open. Fire 'bout to burn all that down.
3.14: Go ahead — draw your water, stack them bricks, mold that clay, fortify the walls all you want…
3.15: But the fire still comin'. The sword still slicin'. The locusts still eatin'. Multiply like you some army of bugs — it won't save you.
3.16: You had merchants swarmin' like stars in the sky — but they flew off with all the loot when stuff got hot.
3.17: Your officials? Just grasshoppers. Campin' out when it's cold, but soon as the sun pop out? Poof — they gone. Don't nobody even know where they went.
3.18: Yo, king of Assyria — your shepherds sleepin'. Your leaders gone. Your people scattered like sheep in the mountains. And ain't nobody comin' to find them.
3.19: Your wound? Yeah, that ain't healin'. Your pain run deep. Everybody who hears this story? Gon' be clappin'. 'Cause ain't nobody escaped the evil you spread for so long.
